mapper.select: SELECT id, worker_id, lease_version, lease_expire_time FROM sr_dag_instance WHERE status = 0 AND next_schedule_time <= #{now} ORDER BY next_schedule_time, id LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_dag_instance SET status = 10, started_at = #{now}, last_progress_time = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{dagInstanceId} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, worker_id, lease_version, lease_expire_time FROM sr_dag_instance WHERE status = 10 AND (lease_expire_time IS NULL OR lease_expire_time > #{now}) ORDER BY last_progress_time, id LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_dag_instance SET status = #{status.code}, success_node_count = #{successCount}, failed_node_count = #{failedCount}, skipped_node_count = #{skippedCount}, finished_at = #{now}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{dagInstanceId} AND status = 10
UPDATE sr_dag_instance SET status = 40, lease_version = lease_version + 1, next_schedule_time = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{dagInstanceId} AND status IN (0, 10)
